goal.name: Ship Cambuz PDF Reader to real readers
goal.description: A fast, quiet, offline PDF reader for Windows and macOS: open a document, read it, find things in it, and remember where you stopped. No accounts, no telemetry, no cloud.

projects.name: Cambuz PDF Reader
projects.description: Tauri 2 shell, React interface, pdf.js rendering engine, SQLite local library. Everything stays on the reader's device.

milestones.name: Foundation
milestones.description: The shell, the toolchain and the data model everything else is built on.

tasks.title: Choose the app name and clear trademark conflicts

tasks.title: Set up the Tauri 2 + React project structure
tasks.description: Workspaces for the shell, the renderer and the shared types; one command builds both.
